title: Final counter shift
statement:
Let $A$ describe $n$ items with keys $kf(j)$, key bound $N_b$, destination range, and counter range, and let $[?]$ and $[?]$ be the initial and current memories. Assume the count-sort layout conditions: memory-space is bounded by word size; source, destination, and counter ranges lie in memory space; source cells contain the indexed items; each item's in-bounds key cell contains its key; all keys are below $N_b$; the source, destination, and counter ranges are pairwise disjoint; and each key cell lies outside the destination and counter ranges.
